job_description: As the Chief Security Officer (CSO) at Müller's Solutions, you will be responsible for developing and implementing a comprehensive security strategy to protect the organization's assets, reputation, and overall business operations. This executive-level position entails overseeing all aspects of security, including physical security, information security, and cybersecurity, aligning security initiatives with the organizational goals.Your role will involve leading a team of security professionals, collaborating with other executives, and serving as the primary point of contact for all security matters. You will ensure that the security policies, standards, and procedures are effectively communicated and adhered to across all levels of the organization.Key Responsibilities:Develop and implement a robust security strategy that encompasses risk management, incident response, and compliance with regulatory and industry standardsLead and manage the security team, providing direction, mentorship, and fostering a culture of security awareness across the organizationConduct regular security audits and assessments to identify vulnerabilities, recommend improvements, and ensure compliance with security policiesServe as a key advisor to senior management on security matters and report on security incidents, risks, and the status of security programsWork closely with IT and operations teams to integrate security measures into the organization's infrastructure and processesDevelop and manage security budgets, ensuring resources are allocated effectively to meet security objectivesStay informed of the latest security threats, trends, and technologies to continuously enhance the organization's security postureRequirementsRequirements:Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, information technology, or a related field; a Master's degree is preferred10+ years of experience in security management, with a proven track record of leadership roles, particularly in a corporate environmentExtensive knowledge of security frameworks and standards including ISO 27001, NIST, and CISProven experience in developing, implementing, and managing security programs related to both cybersecurity and physical securityStrong understanding of risk management practices, incident response protocols, and security incident managementExperience with security technologies, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and data loss prevention toolsExceptional analytical skills and problem-solving abilities, coupled with strong communication and leadership skillsCertification such as CISSP, CISM, or CCISO is highly desirableAbility to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with changing prioritiesPreferred Qualifications:Experience with compliance frameworks such as GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI-DSSExperience in incident response and developing business continuity planningProven ability to influence and drive change at all levels of the organizationBenefitsWhy Join Us:Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team.Competitive salary and benefits package.Exciting projects and innovative work environment.
